answer: Notarized affidavit vetting makes each extra identity pay $15 for one signing before a notary; a farm running N fakes pays N×$15 and cannot share it because one journal entry records one signer, one ID and one signature. The notary checks a government ID, witnesses the signature and logs it in a sequential journal, so a meadow of forged affidavits withers there, a reef of copied signatures breaks, and no juniper cutting signs for a second seat. A farm reusing one entry dies by journal audit at 2: the second seat on one entry voids both seats.
